repairs.prompt: Repair this exact original pixel-art panorama for Oak Creek Canyon, preserving its place, terrain geology, vegetation, structures and existing time-of-day palette. Fix horizontal 360-degree wrap: both outer edges must have matching horizon elevation, sky colors and distant land colors; move tall near trees/cliffs inward from edges rather than change the place. Preserve central recognisable composition. Fade the bottom5% texture gently into a single quiet matching local earth/dark-ground color across the bottommost row, and make the topmost row uniform matching sky color, so clamped pixels don't become long striped extensions. No hard frame, border or contrasting band. Preserve 3:1 panoramic pixel-art, original weather/time, no text/logos/new road or large objects. Do not turn night into daylight or daylight into night.
